preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and K satisfy 1 ≤ K ≤ N ≤ 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line and len(line.split()) > 2)
preconditions.description: Each element in array A satisfies 1 ≤ A_i ≤ 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda A, K: all(A[i] == A[N - 1 - i] for i in range(N // 2)) or any((lambda diffs: all(diff % K == 0 for diff in diffs))(tuple(A[i] - A[N - 1 - i] for i in range(N // 2)))))(*(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line and len(line.split()) > 2) == (lambda output: output.strip().upper() == 'YES')(stdout_line) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if the array can be made palindromic by incrementing K distinct indices any number of times, otherwise 'NO'. This is true if either the array is already palindromic or all pairwise differences between symmetric elements are divisible by K.
